fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-05-21 at about 13:50, it was reported that the brother of the complainant, Divya Kumari, aged 23, left for a bank visit and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Nila Garden Bus Stand Area. The complaint was lodged by Ganesh Natarajan (9000000055), a family member of Divya Kumari, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000152. The complaint refers to Divya Murugan, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000333. Praveen Balan (9000000446) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, associate, photograph, bus stand, witness, afternoon
